title: Matsuri
story: A warm summer night at the village festival.

cards.name: Paper Lantern
cards.subject: A perfectly round red paper lantern with thin horizontal ribs, black cap rims at the top and bottom, and a small white house pictogram printed on the front.
cards.hero_colors: red paper, black rims, white house pictogram

cards.name: Ramune
cards.subject: A light blue glass soda bottle with a long narrow neck holding a small glass marble, an orange cap, and a white wave icon on the body.
cards.hero_colors: light blue glass, orange cap, white wave icon

cards.name: Uchiwa Fan
cards.subject: A flat round paper fan lying flat, with a short flat bamboo handle extending from the bottom and a red circle printed in the middle of the white paper.
cards.hero_colors: white paper, tan bamboo handle, red circle

cards.name: Taiko Drum
cards.subject: A big barrel-shaped taiko drum with two round cream drumheads edged with a ring of round tacks, resting on a low red wooden stand with two curved cradle supports, two wooden sticks lying across the top head.
cards.hero_colors: brown wood barrel, cream drumheads, red stand

cards.name: Geta Sandals
cards.subject: A pair of wooden geta sandals, each a flat oblong wooden board raised on two wooden teeth beneath, with a red cloth thong strap fixed to three holes on top.
cards.hero_colors: light brown wood, red strap

cards.name: Kinchaku Pouch
cards.subject: A small round-bottomed orange fabric pouch with a gathered top tied shut by a white drawstring cord, with a white flower icon on the front.
cards.hero_colors: orange fabric, white cord, white flower icon

cards.name: Candy Apple
cards.subject: A shiny red candy-coated round apple on a straight wooden stick, the stick standing upright in a small wooden block with a hole, with a short green stem at the top.
cards.hero_colors: glossy red apple, light brown stick, small green stem

cards.name: Noren Curtain
cards.subject: A short indigo-blue cloth curtain split into three panels, hanging from a wooden rod fixed across a shop doorway, with a white round icon on the middle panel, seen from the street with a warm lit shop inside.
cards.hero_colors: indigo blue cloth, white round icon, wood rod
cards.surface_or_setting: wooden shop doorway frame seen from the street

cards.name: Wind Chime
cards.subject: A dome-shaped glass bell wind chime with a red circle painted on the glass, a small clapper inside, and a long white paper strip hanging from the clapper, the bell hung by a loop from a hook on a wooden beam.
cards.hero_colors: clear glass, white paper strip, red circle
cards.surface_or_setting: wooden eave beam of a veranda

cards.name: Goldfish
cards.subject: A round clear water-filled plastic bag knotted at the top with a white tie, holding one plump orange goldfish with a fanned tail.
cards.hero_colors: orange goldfish, clear bag, white tie

cards.name: Cotton Candy
cards.subject: A big fluffy round ball of pink cotton candy on a white paper cone with a blue stripe around it.
cards.hero_colors: pink candy floss, white cone, blue stripe

cards.name: Taiko Drum
cards.subject: A big barrel-shaped taiko drum with two round cream drumheads edged with a ring of round tacks, set on a low red wooden stand with two curved cradle supports, standing on a wooden stage floor.
cards.hero_colors: brown wood barrel, cream drumheads, red stand

cards.name: Shaved Ice
cards.subject: A tall rounded mound of white shaved ice in a clear glass cup, drizzled with blue syrup, with a green spoon-straw stuck in the top.
cards.hero_colors: white ice, blue syrup, green spoon-straw

cards.name: Candy Apple
cards.subject: A shiny red candy-coated round apple on a straight wooden stick, with a short green stem at the top, the stick held upright.
cards.hero_colors: glossy red apple, light brown stick, green stem

cards.name: Grilled Corn
cards.subject: A golden corn cob with browned grill marks on a wooden skewer, a few green husk leaves at the base.
cards.hero_colors: golden yellow kernels, light brown skewer, green husk

cards.name: Paper Lantern
cards.subject: A perfectly round white paper lantern with thin horizontal ribs and black cap rims, a blue wave icon on the front, hung from a hook on a wooden post.
cards.hero_colors: white paper, black rims, blue wave icon, light brown post
cards.surface_or_setting: wooden post at a festival ground

cards.name: Watermelon
cards.subject: A half watermelon standing cut-side up, with green striped rind, red flesh and small black seeds.
cards.hero_colors: green striped rind, red flesh, black seeds

cards.name: Straw Hat
cards.subject: A round woven straw hat with a wide cone-shaped brim and a small flat top, tied with a red band around the crown.
cards.hero_colors: golden straw, red band

cards.name: Festival Banner
cards.subject: A tall narrow red cloth banner hanging from a crossbar at the top of a wooden pole, with a white circle icon, the pole planted in the ground.
cards.hero_colors: red cloth, white circle, light brown pole
cards.surface_or_setting: gravel ground of a festival square

cards.name: Goldfish
cards.subject: A single plump orange goldfish swimming sideways with a flowing fanned tail and a white belly.
cards.hero_colors: orange body, white belly

cards.name: Paper Lantern
cards.subject: A perfectly round yellow-orange paper lantern with thin horizontal ribs, black cap rims at the top and bottom, and a small white wave icon on the front.
cards.hero_colors: yellow-orange paper, black rims, white wave icon

cards.name: Pinwheel
cards.subject: A paper pinwheel with four triangular pink and yellow blades folded to a central pin, fixed to a wooden stick.
cards.hero_colors: pink and yellow blades, light brown stick

cards.name: Taiko Drum
cards.subject: A big barrel-shaped taiko drum with two round cream drumheads edged with a ring of round tacks, set on a low red wooden stand with two curved cradle supports.
cards.hero_colors: brown wood barrel, cream drumheads, red stand

cards.name: Poi Scoop
cards.subject: A round goldfish-scooping paper scoop: a thin white paper disc stretched inside a round red plastic ring with a short flat handle, lying flat.
cards.hero_colors: white paper, red plastic ring and handle

cards.name: Folding Fan
cards.subject: An open half-circle folding hand fan with slender bamboo ribs joined at the bottom pivot, covered by white paper with a blue wave icon.
cards.hero_colors: white paper, tan bamboo ribs, blue wave icon

cards.name: Candy Apple
cards.subject: A shiny red candy-coated round apple on a straight wooden stick, standing upright in a small wooden block with a hole, with a short green stem.
cards.hero_colors: glossy red apple, light brown stick, green stem

cards.name: Bamboo Flute
cards.subject: A straight tan bamboo flute, a long hollow tube with a row of round finger holes along it and thin dark red thread wraps near each end, lying flat.
cards.hero_colors: tan bamboo, dark red thread

cards.name: Sparklers
cards.subject: Three thin paper-twist sparklers standing upright in a red metal bucket filled with white sand, each tip a bright fire with a yellow-white glowing core, orange sparks curling outward, and warm orange light cast on the bucket.
cards.hero_colors: red bucket, white sand, white paper sticks, golden sparks
cards.surface_or_setting: packed earth ground of a festival lane

cards.name: Food Stall
cards.subject: A small wooden two-wheeled festival food cart with a counter, a red and white striped awning fixed above on two posts, and a round lantern hung from the awning's front edge.
cards.hero_colors: light brown wood, red and white awning, yellow lantern
cards.surface_or_setting: packed earth ground of a festival lane

cards.name: Goldfish
cards.subject: A round clear glass bowl full of water holding one plump orange goldfish with a fanned tail.
cards.hero_colors: orange goldfish, clear glass bowl
